select epf.id as favorite_id, epf.favorite_time, ep.id, ep.experiment_code, ep.experiment_name, ep.experiment_title, ep.experiment_field, ep.research_hypothesis, ep.experiment_desc, ep.experiment_remark, ep.experiment_contact, ep.contact_phone, ep.contact_email, ep.ethics_audit, ep.experiment_tag, ep.experiment_scene, ep.groups_number, ep.experiment_person_number, ep.experiment_status, ep.intelligent_model, ep.protocol, ep.experiment_attribution, ep.holding_status, ep.creator, ep.create_date, ep.updater, ep.update_date, ep.update_name, su.real_name as create_name, ep.start_time, ep.end_time, ep.publish_time, ep.experiment_style, 1 as is_favorite from t_favorite epf inner join t_experiment_plan ep on epf.target_id = ep.id left join sys_user su on ep.creator = su.id and su.is_deleted = 0 where epf.is_deleted = 0 and ep.is_deleted = 0 and epf.user_id = #{userId} and epf.favorite_type = 'EXPERIMENT_PLAN'
and ep.experiment_name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and ep.experiment_field like concat('%', #{experimentField}, '%')
order by epf.favorite_time desc, epf.id desc

select f.id as favorite_id, f.favorite_time, tm.id, tm.material_type, tm.material_status, tm.material_name, tm.material_data, tm.material_attribution, tm.tag, tm.creator, tm.create_date, tm.updater, tm.update_date, tm.create_name, tm.update_name, tm.url, tm.work_flow, tm.is_review, tm.user_id, tm.role_id, tm.is_delete, tm.experiment_plan_id, 1 as is_favorite from t_favorite f inner join t_material tm on f.target_id = tm.id where f.is_deleted = 0 and tm.is_delete = 0 and f.user_id = #{userId} and f.favorite_type = 'MATERIAL'
and tm.material_type = #{materialType}
and tm.material_name like concat('%', #{materialName}, '%')
order by f.favorite_time desc, f.id desc

select f.id as favorite_id, f.favorite_time, tm.id, tm.model_name, tm.models, tm.model_image_url, tm.user_image_url, tm.greet_info, tm.prompt, tm.temperature, tm.max_tokens, tm.tag, tm.creator, tm.create_date, tm.updater, tm.update_date, tm.create_name, tm.update_name, tm.way, tm.model_status, tm.work_flow, tm.is_review, tm.attribution, tm.experiment_plan_id, tm.user_id, tm.role_id, tm.is_delete, tm.story_setting, tm.role_setting, tm.talking_topic, tm.start_role, tm.subject_role, tm.model_bot_type, tm.response_prompt, tm.response_text, tm.response_time, tm.question, tm.answer, tm.teacher_avatar, tm.student_avatar, tm.config, 1 as is_favorite from t_favorite f inner join t_model tm on f.target_id = tm.id where f.is_deleted = 0 and tm.is_delete = 0 and f.user_id = #{userId} and f.favorite_type = 'AGENT'
and tm.model_name like concat('%', #{modelName}, '%')
order by f.favorite_time desc, f.id desc

select f.id as favorite_id, f.favorite_time, tq.id, tq.questionnaire_name, tq.questionnaire_data, tq.questionnaire_desc, tq.questionnaire_attribution, tq.experiment_plan_id, tq.need_timer, tq.creator, tq.create_date, tq.updater, tq.update_date, tq.status, tq.create_name, tq.update_name, tq.work_flow, tq.is_review, tq.user_id, tq.role_id, tq.is_deleted, 1 as is_favorite from t_favorite f inner join t_questionnaire tq on f.target_id = tq.id where f.is_deleted = 0 and tq.is_deleted = 0 and f.user_id = #{userId} and f.favorite_type = 'QUESTIONNAIRE'
and tq.questionnaire_name like concat('%', #{questionnaireName}, '%')
order by f.favorite_time desc, f.id desc
